name: DeepSeek Harness
description: The DeepSeek Harness (DSH) entry of the general package import: published DSH code plugins are recognised and declined with the reason, and their skill folders can be imported as skill folders. Declarative harness packages imported earlier stay listed, usable and removable; that Xueness-defined format is retired and new ones are refused. Data only; nothing from a package runs.

features.name: DSH 包类型：识别公开发布的 DSH 代码插件并说明不能运行的原因；早先导入的声明式扩展包仍可查看、校验、启用与移除，这种格式已停止导入（只读数据，不运行包内代码）
features.nameEn: DSH package type: recognise published DSH code plugins and explain why they cannot run; declarative packages imported earlier stay viewable, checkable, usable and removable, and that format is no longer imported (data only; package code never runs)
